name: media-transcript-mcp
description: Fetch, search and cite existing YouTube captions and publisher-linked podcast transcripts, or load local SRT, VTT and JSON files. Returns timestamped passages with source links. Runs locally over stdio using the hosted service; free without an account or API key. Does not transcribe audio.
author: Online Solution

MEDIA_TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY.description: Optional API key sent as a Bearer token to the hosted service. Anonymous access works without it.
